pending_ideas.hook: Woman tips a wheelbarrow of wet concrete into a rusted shopping cart lying on its side in a dirt pit.
pending_ideas.why: Large recognizable junk object becoming a water feature hits the proven 95k-644k view range; the cart's wire mesh creates obvious destruction anxiety when concrete pours through it.
pending_ideas.tr: Eski market arabasını bahçe çeşmesine dönüştürüyor.

pending_ideas.hook: Woman submerges an upside-down laundry basket completely into a wide tub of gray concrete, bubbles rising as it sinks.
pending_ideas.why: Large household item to water feature follows the kiddie-pool playbook; the basket's holes create immediate 'this will never work' doubt that drives retention through the pour.
pending_ideas.tr: Plastik çamaşır sepetini kuş banyosuna çeviriyor.

pending_ideas.hook: Woman dips a worn leather jacket collar-first into a barrel of concrete, the sleeves floating then sinking as she pushes it under.
pending_ideas.why: Coated garments consistently land 18k-29k views; leather preserves zippers, collar stitching and texture better than fabric, giving stronger 'ruined something valuable' feeling.
pending_ideas.tr: Eski deri ceketi beton saksıya dönüştürüyor.

pending_ideas.hook: Woman pours concrete from a bucket directly into an open wicker basket, the liquid instantly soaking through the weave onto the ground.
pending_ideas.why: Recognizable object with intricate weave detail that looks impossible to cast; the immediate leaking creates 'she just wasted all that concrete' panic that matches the retention pattern.
pending_ideas.tr: Hasır piknik sepetini taş saksıya çeviriyor.

pending_ideas.hook: Woman stacks three plastic beach buckets upside-down in sand and buries them under shovelfuls of wet concrete mix.
pending_ideas.why: Child's toy to water feature creates massive value gap; burying colorful plastic under concrete triggers 'irreversible mistake' reaction that the data shows keeps viewers to the reveal.
